name: seedance-prompt-library
title_zh: Seedance 2.5 视频提示词模板库
tagline_zh: 写 Seedance 提示词总被生成器带偏？这里每个模板都来自 goodcase.ai 上跑通的高分案例。
tagline_en: Tired of prompts that miss the mark? Each template is reverse-engineered from top-rated Seedance cases on.
desc_en: Verified prompt templates and structures for Seedance 2.5 / 2.0 video generation, distilled from the highest-performing published cases on goodcase.ai. Use when the user asks to write, revise, or review a Seedance video prompt, or asks how to prompt Seedance for a specific kind of shot (narrative short, ad/commercial, UGC talk-to-camera, dialogue with lip-sync, action, product reveal, and similar)
why_zh: 不是泛泛的提示词技巧，而是从真实高分案例里反向拆出的结构。它告诉你哪种镜头该用哪套句式。
why_en: Not generic tips—real structures pulled from winning outputs. It tells you which sentence pattern fits which shot type, saving.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Seedance 2.5/2.0 文生视频的提示词撰写，不含图生视频、音频或运镜参数调优；模板基于公开案例。
limit_en: Only for Seedance 2.5/2.0 text-to-video prompt writing. No image-to-video, audio, or camera-parameter tuning. Templates from public cases; extreme.
title_en: Seedance 2.5 prompt templates distilled from top published.
